observation.source: Real Chromium screenshot and text-range measurements of the live SANCI page with reduced motion enabled.
observation.cause: A text-only empty state was an anonymous child of the four-column countdown CSS grid and therefore occupied only its first column.

change.fix: The next-stream clock with no datetime renders as a centered full-width block; a real datetime keeps the four-cell grid. The public stylesheet cache token is bumped.
